# Unstuck by Mai G. Mislang
# https://workaroundtraffic.com

## About This Site
This is the official landing page for *Unstuck: How To Work Around Traffic When Government Won't Really Help* by Mai G. Mislang.

## About the Book
- **Full title:** Unstuck: How To Work Around Traffic When Government Won't Really Help
- **Author:** Mai G. Mislang
- **Published:** 2026
- **Available on:** Amazon Kindle and paperback (June 15, 2026)
- **Amazon link:** https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GYHN6D1D

## Core Argument
Metro Manila's traffic crisis is not primarily a government failure — it is a corporate policy failure. Organizations have the power and responsibility to implement alternative work arrangements (AWAs) right now, without waiting for transit infrastructure.

## Who It's For
- HR leaders and People Operations executives
- C-suite and senior management in the Philippines and other congested cities
- Knowledge workers and managers looking to advocate for policy change
- Organizations in Metro Manila and other traffic-congested urban centers globally

## Key Concepts
- Bandwidth tax: the cognitive and physical cost of commuting that depletes worker productivity
- Alternative work arrangements (AWAs): flexible schedules, remote work, compressed workweeks
- The 9-to-5 as a historical relic unsuited to modern congested cities
- Corporate policy as the lever for change, not government transit timelines

## Author
Mai G. Mislang is a Manila-based author, educator, and content creator. She also runs Rise Artisanal, a sourdough bakery, and leads communications work in the nonprofit sector.

## Newsletter
The Bandwidth Conservator — weekly essays on alternative work arrangements and systemic inefficiencies. Subscribe at: https://maimislang.substack.com
